levels.surface: عبد الله ابني محمد بن عيسى

notes: the compiler's own statement of how he holds the book's material from عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي (not a saying): several routes, written in clauses separated by «؛», so the reading is by clause

the first clause «فقد رويته عن أبي» writes the father and stops; the second clause «و محمد بن الحسن ... عن سعد بن عبد الله» stops before the names that meet at محمد بن أبي عمير: those routes break as written, and the archive should rule how they join

the third and fourth clauses write the names through محمد بن أبي عمير and حماد بن عثمان to عبيد الله بن علي الحلبي themselves, so they are complete; «عن عمه عبد الله بن عامر» is one link (rule 7); the bare «أبي» in the first clause is the compiler's father, relation; the blessings are left out
